/memories/session-03.md:L46: Dave: Last weekend I went to a car show. Classic cars are so charming and the dedication people put into restoring them is amazing. That's why I'm so into auto engineering. Can't wait to show you some when you come to Boston! Oh, almost forgot to send a photo, look at this beautiful car!

/memories/session-04.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin, long time no see! A lot's been happening since we last talked. Guess what? I finally opened my own car maintenance shop! It's so satisfying to have a spot to work on cars - it's like a dream come true! Take a look at the photo.

/memories/session-08.md:L23: Dave: Hey, nice photo of the studio! Working in a team yields incredible results, well done! Keep pushing it! I've been doing good - thanks for asking. I've been exploring some parks on the weekends to relax - it's so peaceful being surrounded by nature. Are there any chill spots you enjoy in Boston?
/memories/session-08.md:L27: [Image caption: a photo of a tree with pink flowers in the foreground]

/memories/session-08.md:L41: [Image caption: a photo of a plane flying over a mountain range with snow on the top]
/memories/session-09.md:L12: Calvin: Hi Dave! Nice to hear from you. Since last chat, some things have happened. I had a lil car accident last Friday, kinda upsetting but no one was hurt. I've been dealing with insurance and repairs - taking up a lot of time and energy. Look at this photo!
/memories/session-09.md:L13: [Image caption: a photo of a red car with a black rim parked on a sidewalk]
/memories/session-09.md:L20: [Image caption: a photo of a tow truck parked in a parking lot]
/memories/session-09.md:L26: Calvin: It only took a week to sort everything out. I was worried about the cost, but it wasn't too bad. Look at this photo from the auto repair shop. 
/memories/session-09.md:L27: [Image caption: a photography of a man working on a car in a garage]

/memories/session-09.md:L59: [Image caption: a photo of a person on skis on a snowy mountain]
/memories/session-09.md:L68: Dave: Yes, Cal! I recently joined a rock band and have been practicing guitar. Look at this photo – it's us, the guys!

/memories/session-10.md:L27: [Image caption: a photo of a city skyline with a river and boats in the water]
/memories/session-10.md:L30: Calvin: Wow, what a view! That sunset over the river is gorgeous. It must be so tranquil there. Reminds me of living in my Japanese mansion with the epic cityscape. It's like a dream come true! Look at this photo I took from my backyard of the mansion. It's so beautiful!

Working with artists from around the globe and challenging myself to create special music are goals of mine too. Look at the photo of how I performed with the boys last night, they are great at the music!

/memories/session-15.md:L12: Dave: Hey Calvin! Haven't talked in a while! Last Friday I had a card-night with my friends, it was so much fun. We laughed and had a great time! Take a look at the photo!
/memories/session-15.md:L13: [Image caption: a photography of a group of men sitting at a table with playing cards]
/memories/session-15.md:L28: Calvin: It was an incredible experience, Dave! The city was buzzing with energy and the festival crowd was so lively - it was like fuel for my soul. Look at this photo, that's amazing!
/memories/session-15.md:L29: [Image caption: a photo of a crowd of people sitting on the grass at night]

/memories/session-16.md:L29: Calvin: Cool! Last weekend I started shooting a video for my new album - can't wait for you to check it out! Look how great it was!
/memories/session-16.md:L30: [Image caption: a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach]
/memories/session-16.md:L36: Calvin: We're doing the shoot in Miami and picked an awesome beach. It's going to have some epic visuals!
/memories/session-16.md:L51: Dave: Sure, let me know when, I'm here to lend a hand. It's great to fuel your ideas. Remember that photo you sent me once? Love how this guitar shows our different artistic styles.

/memories/session-23.md:L27: Calvin: Wow Dave, sounds awesome! Music festivals bring so much joy and the energy of the crowd can be amazing. Got any photos from the festival? I'd love to check them out and join in on the fun.
/memories/session-23.md:L31: [Image caption: a photo of a stage with a crowd of people watching a band]
/memories/session-23.md:L58: Calvin: C'mon, remember how great you are! Keep going for those dreams. You got this! You know what Dave? Last week, I got a new Ferrari! It's a masterpiece on wheels. Excited for thrilling rides and unforgettable journeys! Perhaps a photo of this unique beauty will lift your mood.

/memories/session-10.md:L30: Calvin: Wow, what a view! That sunset over the river is gorgeous. It must be so tranquil there. Reminds me of living in my Japanese mansion with the epic cityscape. It's like a dream come true! Look at this photo I took from my backyard of the mansion. It's so beautiful!
/memories/session-10.md:L31: [Image caption: a photo of a boat is docked in a canal at sunset]
/memories/session-16.md:L16: Calvin: Hey Dave! The tour was amazing! I was so pumped from all the energy from the audience. This pic totally captures how I felt. Such an amazing time!
/memories/session-16.md:L30: [Image caption: a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach]
/memories/session-19.md:L22: Calvin: Aww, bummer! I would've loved to hear that music. Oh well, some of the best memories can't be captured on video or audio. It's like those special moments that stay in our hearts and minds. Take a look at this cool Disney poster!
/memories/session-25.md:L39: Calvin: Yeah, for sure! Recently, I've been really inspired by some of the struggles that people go through. It's made me dig deeper into my music to try to capture those feelings.
/memories/session-25.md:L97: Dave: Yeah, for sure Calvin! Concerts are awesome, they bring people together and create such a cool vibe. You can feel the energy in the air. Take a look at this unforgettable moment that I captured at the concert.
/memories/session-27.md:L21: Dave: Look at this magnificent sunset I captured on camera. It's truly breathtaking to witness such beautiful sunsets! The sky looks like it's on fire!
/memories/session-27.md:L22: [Image caption: a photo of a city skyline at sunset with a clock tower]
/memories/session-27.md:L35: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Your kind words mean a lot. Yep, that's the clock tower in the last photo. I snapped it at sunset and the colors were stunning. Photography helps me capture and appreciate the beauty of nature. It's been an awesome creative outlet and I'm loving it.
/memories/session-30.md:L20: [Image caption: a photo of a boat is floating in the water at sunset]
/memories/session-30.md:L27: Dave: That's amazing, Calvin! Music really does bring people together and foster creativity. Glad to hear you had such an inspiring conversation! Take a look at my new vintage camera that I bought this month, which takes awesome photos!
/memories/session-30.md:L28: [Image caption: a photo of a camera sitting on a table next to a plant]
/memories/session-30.md:L31: Calvin: Hey Dave, music really brings people together, huh? Do you use this camera for photos? They always turn out so good!
/memories/session-30.md:L34: Dave: Yes, Calvin, this camera is very good, it helps me capture those special moments really clearly.
/memories/session-30.md:L37: Calvin: Having a good camera is key for capturing those special moments. What do you like to take photos of?
/memories/session-30.md:L38: [Image caption: a photo of a sunset with a wave crashing on rocks]
/memories/session-30.md:L41: Dave: Yeah, being able to take good pics is key. I love capturing the beauty of nature - sunsets, beaches, waves. Just got this one recently, check this out!
/memories/session-30.md:L42: [Image caption: a photo of a sunset with a wave crashing on rocks]
